summary: Retest of the shift-closure receipt prompt (CAISSIER), with real Playwright clicks. PASS on both cycles. Cycle 1: close with 1000000, then shift-receipt-prompt visible; opening modal NOT visible on 7 checks over ~2s; a real page.click on shift-receipt-no works; the prompt closes, then 'Ouverture de Caisse' appears. Cycle 2: open (1500), close, prompt; no opening modal during 2s; a real click on shift-receipt-print works; window.open called 1 time; the prompt closes, then the opening modal appears. Bug (b) from iteration_2 is fixed.

ui_bugs.issue: step="100" triggers native HTML5 validation: the requested amount 999999 is rejected ('Please enter a valid value. The two nearest valid values are 999900 and 1000000') and the form will not submit. A cashier cannot enter a counted amount that is not a multiple of 100. Use step="any" or step="1".

The default end time is eligibility.suggested_end_time (the schedule end, e.g. 23:59) and is not capped to max_duration_hours. Clicking 'Ouvrir le shift' then fails with 'La durée du shift ne peut pas dépasser 8 heures. Durée actuelle: 19.3h', so the cashier has to correct the time by hand. Cap it with min(schedule end, now + max_duration_hours).

action_items: Change step=100 to step=any on actual-amount-input (and opening-amount-input)
Cap the default end time in OpenShiftModal to now + max_duration_hours
critical_code_review_comments: ShiftModals.jsx finishClose() calls onSuccess and then onClose only after the user answers the prompt. With Layout.js gating on !showCloseShiftModal, this correctly keeps the opening modal from showing early.
The 'Clôturer le shift' button in the Layout header has no data-testid (only title=...).
seed_data_creation: A TEST_schedule shift schedule for the cashier (2026-11-15) was created and then deleted. 2 test shifts were opened and closed for the cashier (opening 1500, counted 1000000). The cashier ends with no open shift.
